curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42031-1-1.pdf (the cherry picker); omr/instructions/42031-1-2.pdf builds the B model, a tow truck

functions.does: The black knob at the back of the boom's yellow mount turns a worm, which turns the 24-tooth gear on the boom's pivot and raises or lowers the boom; the worm holds the boom wherever it's left.
functions.source: book: steps 33-34 and 37 (pages 27, 32), the boom's gear in step 35.7 (page 30)

functions.does: The whole boom, with its yellow mount, turns round on a single upright pin on top of the chassis behind the cab.
functions.source: book: step 39 (page 36), the mount is set on the chassis's upright pin; that it slews freely is inferred from the single pin

functions.does: The work basket hangs from the boom tip on pins and a pin joiner, so it swings and swivels and can be kept upright as the boom rises.
functions.source: book: step 38.7 and 39 (pages 35-36); inferred: which ways it swings, from the pins it hangs on (unsure whether it tilts about the boom-tip cross block or only swivels on the joiner)

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely, each on its own pin; there's no steering.

questions.question: Does the basket tilt, and is slewing a function?
